title: South and Central Vietnam Tour Package
highlights: Experience the magic of Vietnam with the modern city life of Ho Chi Minh City and the ancient architecture of Hoi An.
Witness firsthand the remarkable resilience of the Vietnamese people at the Cu Chi Tunnels, an extensive 250-kilometre underground network built over 25 years during the Vietnam War.
Explore the tranquil waterways of the Mekong Delta, a lush paradise of floating markets and vibrant local life.
Marvel at the intricate wooden carvings and Chinese zodiac statues adorning the Japanese Covered Bridge in Hoi An.
Admire the architectural marvel of Linh Ung Pagoda, a serene coastal sanctuary offering panoramic views of the South China Sea.
overview:
About the tour:
Witness the vibrant energy of Ho Chi Minh City, where ancient pagodas stand tall amidst modern skyscrapers. Immerse yourself in the city's rich history with a visit to the Cu Chi Tunnels, an important reminder of the city's past. Venture beyond the city to the Mekong Delta, experiencing the tranquil beauty of river life and the warm hospitality of local villagers.


Continue your journey to the coastal gem of Da Nang, boasting pristine beaches, bustling cafes, and rolling hills. Adrenaline seekers can explore the thrilling attractions of Ba Na Hills, while history buffs will appreciate the charm of Hoi An, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This tour offers a perfect blend of urban excitement, natural beauty, and cultural immersion.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at the Tan Son Nhat International Airport, get transferred to the hotel to check in. Later, set out to explore the nearby attractions on your own. Experience the city's vibrant atmosphere at iconic landmarks like the Ben Thanh Market, a shopper's paradise, and the Saigon River, offering scenic boat tours. You can also spend the evening indulging in local cuisine and experiencing the city's nightlife. Finally, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City and Cu Chi Tunnels Tour
days.desc: Enjoy the day exploring Ho Chi Minh City and Cu Chi Tunnels. From the hotel, get transferred to the Cu Chi Tunnels, known as the underground network used during the Vietnam War. Afterward, return to Ho Chi Minh City and visit the Reunification Palace and War Remnants Museum. Then, explore the iconic Saigon Central Post Office, a stunning example of French colonial architecture and a former hub of communication, before getting transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mekong Delta Tour
days.desc: On this day, get transferred from the hotel to explore the Mekong Delta on a sightseeing tour. Spend some time at a popular Buddhist shrine in Vietnam, Ving Trang Pagoda, followed by a visit to the Tortoise Islet. Then, take a boat ride from My Tho along the Mekong River and sail past fish cages and floating houses. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Da Nang | Day Trip to Hoi An
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get transferred to board your flight at Tan Son Nhat Airport to reach Da Nang. Upon arrival at Da Nang International Airport, get driven to the hotel and check in. Later, board your pre-booked transfer for a day trip to Hoi An to see the famous Japanese Covered Bridge and Assembly Hall Of Fujian. End your day by enjoying a boat ride along the Thu Bon River. Later, get dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Ba Na Hills
days.desc: From your hotel, get transferred to Suoi Mo Station to board a cable car to Ba Na Hills. On your trip today, visit the famous Golden Hand Bridge, an architectural wonder at over 1400 high that appears to be suspended in mid-air by two giant hands. Learn about the wine making process at the Debay Wine Cellar and enjoy diverse thrilling rides at Fantasy Park. Also, head to Linh Ung Pagoda, housing a 67 metre high Lady Buddha statue. Finally, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
